name: Inference Latency Assessment
summary: Measure inference latency percentiles (p50, p95, p99) and validate against real-time thresholds
purpose: Measure inference latency percentiles (p50, p95, p99) and validate against real-time thresholds. Report all latency statistics with evidence.
assignment_instructions: You are assessing inference latency for a model deployment. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "compute_inference_latency_v1" - agent_summary (string) - inputs_used (list of strings) - missing_inputs (list of strings) - claims (list of objects): claim, evidence_reference, confidence ("provided"|"inferred"|"missing") - calculations (list of objects): name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions - risks (list of objects): risk, severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string) - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include: - model_name (string) - gpu_model (string) - batch_size (integer) - total_requests (integer): number of requests in benchmark - latency_p50_ms (number): 50th percentile latency in milliseconds - latency_p95_ms (number): 95th percentile latency in milliseconds - latency_p99_ms (number): 99th percentile latency in milliseconds - latency_unit (string): must be "ms" - real_time_threshold_ms (number): threshold for real-time, default 100 - meets_real_time (boolean): latency_p99_ms < real_time_threshold_ms - p99_to_p50_ratio (number): latency_p99_ms / latency_p50_ms - tail_latency_severity (string): "low" if p99/p50 < 2, "medium" if 2-5, "high" if > 5 Compute meets_real_time as latency_p99_ms < real_time_threshold_ms (strictly less than). Compute p99_to_p50_ratio as latency_p99_ms / latency_p50_ms. Return numeric values as numbers, not prose. All latency values must be in milliseconds. Include percentile formulas in calculations array. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
